<subject>Re: Christopher Jackson</subject>
<body>
The vast majority of this language is already in the guarantee in the form of waivers—I have no problem in saying the same thing 2 different ways, if it will expedite the deal. Any objections?
</body>
<quoted>
-----Original Message-----
From: r420@solbritech.com
Sent: Friday, 4 July 2025 5:00 PM
To: alexander.huber@tasmanridge.com.au; Michael michael.ochoa@tasmanridge.com.au; melissa.nelson@tasmanridge.com.au; k721@solbritech.com; j401@solbritech.com
Subject: Re: Christopher Jackson

The revised Jackson is acceptable except that I would like to see the first sentence of Section 1 read as follows:

     Subject to the provisions hereof, Guarantor hereby irrevocably and unconditionally guarantees the timely payment when due of the obligations (including, without limitation, all renewals, extensions and modifications thereof, and all interest, fees and other monetary obligations incurred or accrued during the pendency of any bankruptcy, insolvency, receivership or other similar proceeding, regardless of whether allowed or allowable in such proceeding) of Tasman Ridge Resources Ltd to Pilbara Bulk Logistics under the Rail Access Agreement (the " Obligations").

Please let me know where we are with respect to the Haulage Agreement. Are you preparing such an agreement?

-----Original Message-----
From: alexander.huber@tasmanridge.com.au
Sent: Friday, 4 July 2025 11:42 AM
To: Justin Page; katrina.howell@tasmanridge.com.au; michael.ochoa@tasmanridge.com.au; melissa.nelson@tasmanridge.com.au; Michael
Subject: Christopher Jackson

I have tried to address the points raised during our phone call. Note that some of the rewording in the introductory paragraph is to accommodate documentation that is being proposed by the Port Access group here, and which will be distributed shortly.
